releaseNotes: CLIENT OCC CONFLICT MICRO-FIX (v13.98): Xu ly an toan HTTP 409 phia client, ngan chan vong lap retry vo han, luu trang thai xung dot ro rang.
changelog:
- Xu ly HTTP 409 (OCC Conflict) an toan o phia client: dat hasConflict=true, ghi conflictRevision va conflictBaseRevision.
- Ngan chan vong lap retry vo han: 409 huy hasPendingSave truoc khi finally chay.
- finally block chi retry khi hasPendingSave=true VA khong co xung dot (hasConflict=false).
- 200 success xoa co xung dot (hasConflict=false, conflictRevision=undefined, conflictBaseRevision=undefined).
- 409 phan biet ro khoi loi mang: khong trigger offline fallback.
- Bo sung 12 test moi trong tests/client_occ_conflict.test.js bao phu toan bo ranh gioi 409.
